name: Trance (Switch Angel style)
key_tendency: Minor keys with i-VI-III-VII (A minor: Am F C G); uplifting but minor.
signature: Fast 16th supersaw arps that climb through the chord tones
Trance gate: a chopped supersaw chord pattern (struct with gaps)
Offbeat or rolling saw bass on the root
Breakdown with the pad alone, then a riser into the drop
Live-coded feel: one line changes at a time, often the arp pattern
listen_for: The gated supersaw makes the chord stutter in a fixed rhythm while the 16th arp runs over it. The arp is the hook: when it moves to a new chord, the whole track lifts.

parts.bass:
const bass = note("<a1 f1 c2 g1>").struct("[~ x]*4").s("sawtooth")
  .lpf(700).decay(0.15).sustain(0).gain(0.45)
parts.pad:
const pad = chord("<Am F C G>").voicing().s("supersaw")
  .attack(0.5).release(1.5).lpf(2000).room(0.9).size(0.9).gain(0.16)

starter.arrange:
arrange(
  [16, stack(drums, bass)],
  [8, stack(pad, lead.lpf(1200))],
  [8, stack(chords, lead.lpf(2000), fx, roll)],
  [16, stack(drums, bass, chords, lead)],
  [8, stack(drums, bass, pad)],
)
